sources.snippet: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model. It is trained on a large dataset of diverse audio and is also a multitasking model that can perform multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification.

sources.title: whisper-large-v2: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview whisper-large-v2 is a multilingual automatic speech recognition and speech translation model built by openai that handles audio transcription and translation without fine-tuning. The model is a Transformer-based encoder-decoder (sequence-to-sequence) architecture with 1,550M parameters, trained on 680k hours of labelled speech data via large-scale weak supervision.
